entities.name: Seleucid Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Seleucid Empire, a political institution in Syria during Hellenistic and Roman Syria (330 BCE–64 BCE). Led to the emergence of Maccabean and Antioch founded — becomes one of the four great cities of the ancient world.
